column2: - Easier to raise love points.\n- Higher success rate for actions that increase love.\n- Sexual chemistry rises faster.

- Popularity rises easier.\n- Friendly NPCs will also gain love points.

- Lower success rate for touch and affectionate commands? (Success rate is about 30% lower than a character without the tsundere trait.)
- May abruptly want to break up with a lover.
- The success rate for romantic commands will occasionally drop. Complaints, apologies, and interrupting conversations will fix this.
- Disliked commands (such as failure to touch) increase like points. Thus, characters on bad terms may suddenly become lovers.
- Higher chance of interrupting conversations with liked characters?
- Easier to raise like points.\n- Higher success rate for 'suggestion' and 'good deed' commands.\n- Higher utilization of insulting and violent commands against disliked characters.
- Higher success rate when interacting with popular characters.
- Higher success rate for commands such as confessions, but also insulting and complaining.
- Resistant to depressed moods.\n- Higher success rate for encouraging commands.
- Hates seeing others engaging in physical affection or public sex.\n- Lower chance to ask others on dates.
- Higher chance to interrupt conversations and contest public sex.
- Susceptible to depressed moods. Becomes depressed after witnessing fights.\n- Higher chance for romantic advances to fail after witnessing others fool around.

- Higher success rate for erotic commands. May agree to sex with a character of low virtue on the first meeting.

- Lower chance of interrupting public sex; may begin masturbating.
- Sexual chemistry rises faster.
- Increased chance to attend classes and club activities.\n- Will not accept invitations to skip class.\n- Increased chance of interrupting public sex.
- Mood is less prone to ups and downs.\n- Lower chance of interrupting conversations and physical affection. However, they will interrupt the latter if one party is their lover.
- Has intense mood swings.
- Attends school later, goes home earlier.
- Higher chance of fighting and slapping.
- Lower chance of confessing and being physically affectionate.

- Higher chance of encouraging depressed characters and offering massages.\n- Easily becomes popular, but people will dislike them if they are unpopular and make mistakes.\n- Higher chance of using 'encouragement', 'good deeds', and 'interaction' commands on good friends?

- Will often visit the cafeteria.
- Can eat multiple times during lunch break.
- Higher chance of inviting others/being invited to eat out.
- Higher chance of talking about love.\n- Will invite others on dates, even if they already have a lover. (Characters with the single-minded trait will rarely do this, even if they have a lover.)
- Will not accept confessions, physical affection, or sex from others if they are not their lover, even if their virtue is low.
- Won't choose between two people during a competition.\n- May double-book dates.

- Will spread bad rumours.

- Will become sexually aroused and gain love points when insulted. (Unlike other commands, there is no limit to the amount of times this can be performed.)\n- Higher chance of 'accepting' forced sex. (However, since the forced sex flag is still raised, it is harder for the character to accept.)

In fact, the answer functions like 'No', but it does not affect favourability, and will not count towards 'number of times rejected' if the character is confessing.)\n- In the case of NPCs, this trait will make it harder to recover from a bad state when combined with the wild trait and a hostile mood.
